pages.text: $(bold)Bio Composite$() is the base material for Hemp Plastic and is used in several other recipes.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Two ways to make it:$()$(br)$(br)$(bold)Early game (Crafting Table):$() Use the Hemp Hammer with 3 Hemp Leaf + 1 Hemp Fiber. This consumes 1 hammer durability per craft (12 crafts per hammer).$(br)$(br)$(bold)Mid game (Extractor):$() Put Hemp Leaf in the Extractor for a cheaper and renewable source of Bio Composite that does not consume a hammer.
Early-game route: Hemp Hammer + 3 Hemp Leaf + 1 Hemp Fiber → Bio Composite.
